BiblicalUsage: Zereth-shahar is a town in Reuben, east of the Jordan, named in Joshua's list of the land. In Joshua 13:19, Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that a place like Zereth-shahar is worth knowing because God's story unfolded there.
